findingDetails.summary: Hosted sticky navigation obscures the2026-10-25 release-note title in all4 captures: fully on mobile and partially on desktop.
findingDetails.cause: Capture helper scrolls Release Notes heading to20px without accounting for hosted sticky-header height. Raw local source captures did not include injected navigation.
findingDetails.requiredCorrection: Preserve original receipts/images. Recapture4 variants with the heading below sticky navigation, using new immutable attempt-specific filenames. Inspect date/title and both paragraphs fully visible. No application-source defect or style change is indicated.

limits: Actual first hosted staging image review only. Browser checks4/4 and identity observations remain valid, but DOM visibility did not prove title pixels unobscured. No production acceptance.
